reason: The methane store matches the lander's methane tank, so this should begin filling the separate flight tanks.
expectation: I expect methane to transfer into its flight tank, though I don't know whether it will fill in one step.

alternatives.reason: The oxygen tank also needs filling, but either matching transfer seems like a reasonable place to start.

effect: The methane transferred into its dedicated flight tank, leaving the oxygen tank to fill.
reaction: The separate transfer line makes the distinction between the two liquids clear.
reason: The oxygen store matches the remaining flight tank, and this is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect liquid oxygen to transfer into its own tank through its dedicated line.

effect: The oxygen transfer filled the separate oxidizer tank and completed the chapter. The result explains that fuel and oxidizer meet later in the engine.
reaction: The engine detail made the separate tanks feel purposeful, though the transfer itself was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the oxygen tank was most worthwhile because the result connected the separate stores to their eventual use in the engine.

leastWorthwhile.text: The methane transfer felt routine: the matching tank made the action obvious, and the result largely confirmed it.

surprise.text: The explanation that fuel and oxidizer will meet in the engine added a useful connection between the two transfers.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; each liquid had a clearly matching tank and transfer line.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the return and the specimens' journey unfold. The tank transfers themselves offered little decision-making, but they brought the return closer.
